method: candidate lines proposed by corridor detection; identity decided from printed address runs and street-name labels
why_not_one_block_off: Sheet 25 covers 9th-12th, sheet 30 covers 12th-15th, so 12th is the only shared street. Both plates print the name in the corridor: sheet 25 '12TH ST.' along its bottom edge, sheet 30 '12TH ST.' along its top edge, and both print the corridor width '80'' inside it. Address runs pin the block: on sheet 25 the north frontage of 12th St reads 1202 1204 1206 1208 1210 1212 | 1214 1216 1218 1220 1222 1224 (the Ave L-Ave M block, with the 20' alley splitting it after 1212); on sheet 30 the south frontage of the same street reads 1103 1105 1107 1109 1111 | 1113 1115 1117 1119 1121 1123 (the Ave K-Ave L block), with the Ave L corner run 1202 1204 1206 turning south. That K-L=1100 / L-M=1200 numbering is internally consistent and fixes 12th, not 11th (sheet 25's next street north, faces 2396/2638) or 13th (sheet 30's next street south, faces 1245/1485). Detection's candidates (25: 3191/2065/940; 30: 354/1435/2517/3599) sit ~465 px off the true street centres and were discarded. Positions taken as the mid-line of the 80' corridor from its two block-face rules: sheet 25 faces y=3549 and y=3791 -> 3670; sheet 30 faces y=99 and y=338 -> 217.
